name: swarm
description: Set up Swarm locally and delegate work to your own agents through MCP. Remote access is optional.

interface.longDescription: Get your own Swarm running, connect a model provider and workspace, and delegate tasks to its agents. This local package requires a desktop execution environment that supports local MCP processes. Setup can help install Swarm; installing this plugin alone does not install the daemon. ChatGPT private tunnels and authenticated relays are optional, separately configured connections.
defaultPrompt: Set up Swarm on this computer and connect it locally.
Delegate a task to my Swarm.
